svg.title: Chess rules and the AI engine
svg.desc: chess/ + game/ai_player. Board is a mailbox (a1 = 0 … h8 = 63) with an incremental Zobrist key; make_move / undo_move are exact inverses. Engine = iterative-deepening alpha-beta + quiescence + transposition table. AIPlayer turns a difficulty into a search budget.
